notes.title: Demo 0.10.6 Update
notes.content:
We're currently developing an outdoor exploration and resource collection system, but it hasn't been implemented yet.

Pixels make up 90% of the game's size, and we'll strive to reduce the file size without sacrificing image quality.

Subsequent updates may experience lower or higher pixel quality due to these adjustments.

Update:

Added some map details

Added footstep sounds for stepping on water

Added Sirius' shop-watching animation

Added effects and sounds for sinks

Added ESC function to close windows

Added required furniture for recipes

Adjusted walkable areas for lakes and rivers

Adjusted alignment of roads with terrain

Furniture and tools will now automatically populate the quick access slot (furniture placement will now include aiming functionality)

Fixed character sleeping animations, allowing players to wake them up in the middle of the night

Fixed an issue where characters would disappear when downstairs in a player's house

Reduced game size to 1.22G

notes.title: Demo 0.10.1 Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on the rhythm game and the final event.

The last update for this area was last year's Bloodstain 2.



Update:

Increased the responsiveness of the rhythm game and invasion events.

Added basic rhythm game sound effects.

Increased difficulty adjustment for invasion events.

Added a basic tutorial for invasion events.

Added sound effects and special effects for invasion events.

Added a health bar for invasion events.

Improved the continuous click gameplay for invasion events.

Improved the attack range determination for the rhythm game.

Reduces flashing in the plot and dims the highlighted screen.

Fixed a bug where the invasion event could be exited.

Fixed a bug where the shop screen would freeze due to frequent opening and closing.

notes.title: Demo v0.10.0 Update
notes.content:
We've finally fixed all the more serious issues and can move on to other development. 



Update:

Added a jump function

Added a 24-hour shop, eliminating the need to wait for NPCs to arrive

Added underwater camera visual effects (this was just a quick use, as the game doesn't plan on letting players go underwater)

Added two types of flowers

Improved the background music system

Revised the inventory and quick menu functionality (a future update will allow players to place furniture directly without entering the layout mode)

Fixed some scene issues

Fixed a bug where NPCs would move while browsing the shop

Optimized loading times at game startup

notes.title: Demo v0.9.20 Update
notes.content:
Because some people are experiencing serious issues that are preventing them from playing,

This update primarily addresses the bug reporting feature. This button can be found on the pause screen in the game.

For the developer's protection, you must agree to this data collection statement. Please understand.



Update Content:

Added bug reporting functionality

Minor adjustments to interaction distances

Added a quick item slot at the bottom (not yet linked to the item slot)

Adjusted the interaction distance for the cafe sign

Fixed an issue with the story system dialog resetting

Fixed an issue with background music switching being triggered by regular NPCs

notes.title: Demo v0.9.19 Update
notes.content:
Thanks again for your feedback. This update also addresses the bugs we've collected.



Update Content:

Added the ability to save and access game settings.

Reduced the sense of slippage when moving players.

Reduced camera vibration between stopping and moving.

Removed the player's transition time between picking up and placing items.

Adjusted the player's interaction range in the cafe game.

Adjusted the distance between the follow type UI and edges.

Adjusted the labels for interactable trees and rocks.

Fixed the sound effect group settings for items.

Fixed tutorial to lock the system button.

Fixed UI for the Cafe mini-game, crafting table, and research upgrades to move to other areas.

Fixed objects to fade in and out incorrectly, obscuring the screen.

Fixed objects to interact with other items during a long interaction.

Fixed hand-held IK to behave incorrectly after a character sat down.

Fixed the time display to display incorrectly.

Fixed the background music to change incorrectly quickly.

Fixed the Cafe test to end immediately after opening hours.

Fixed drop protection to not transmit correctly.

notes.title: Demo v0.9.16 Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for your feedback and bug reports!



Update Notes:

Added a safeguard mechanism to prevent the player from falling out of the world

Reduced game size from 7.5GB to 2.1GB

Adjusted visual effects of the 2D tutorial guide

Fixed missing and misaligned text issues

Fixed a bug where the camera dropped when the character stood on wall edges

Fixed a time freeze bug that occurred when replaying

Fixed an issue where item info cards would get stuck on the screen

Fixed a bug where the fire extinguisher would remain stuck in the character’s hand after closing the café
